### `POST /cluster/bulk-action/guest/migrate`

```ts
proxmox.cluster["bulk-action"].guest.migrate.$post()
```

Bulk migrate all guests on the cluster.

Returns `string`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max-workers` | number |  | Defines the maximum number of tasks running concurrently. — min 1, max 64, default `1` |
| `maxworkers` | number |  | Defines the maximum number of tasks running concurrently. Deprecated, use 'max-workers' instead. — min 1, max 64, default `1` |
| `online` | boolean |  | Enable live migration for VMs and restart migration for CTs. |
| `target` | string | yes | Target node. — format `pve-node` |
| `vms` | number[] |  | Only consider guests from this list of VMIDs. |
| `with-local-disks` | boolean |  | Enable live storage migration for local disk |
